$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs (manager/rules/SEO.md) after every deploy. actorId pins the Actor created by the first deploy (2026-11-10, build 1.0.1), so a rename keeps the same Actor. isPublic stays false (owner, 2026-11-10: keep it private). Prices are placeholders until they are measured on Apify (Phase B); apply false until then, so CI sends no pricing.
seoTitle: eFinancialCareers Jobs Scraper - Finance Jobs, Pay
seoDescription: Search every eFinancialCareers job by title, city, sector and seniority: quant, risk, compliance and banking roles, with pay, agency flag and apply link.
defaultRunOptions$comment: 1 GB until Apify runs measure 512 MB, 1 GB and 2 GB (Phase B). Locally the empty form took 22 to 25 s and peaked under 200 MB.

pricing.$comment: PLACEHOLDER prices, not measured: Phase B measures the cost on Apify and sets them by the owner's 80-100% markup ladder (BRIEF.md section 10). apply false: CI sends no pricing until then.

pricingInfos.reasonForChange: First pricing: measured cost plus an 80-100% markup by tier

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, place, contract and job type, sectors, pay as shown and as numbers, whether an agency posted it, skills, first posting date and link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, the employer's own apply link when the job is applied for there, the job reference and the city, region and country.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
